Title: Data Analyst
Description: Objetivo del puesto Analizar información de negocio y comportamiento de usuarios para generar insights que permitan optimizar la adquisición, retención, monetización y experiencia de los clientes en los productos de Sportsbook, Casino, Casino en Vivo y Poker. Será responsable de transformar datos en información accionable mediante reportes, dashboards y análisis que apoyen la toma de decisiones de las áreas de Marketing, CRM, Producto y Dirección. Responsabilidades Generar reportes periódicos sobre KPIs clave del negocio. Construir y mantener dashboards en Power BI Analizar el desempeño de campañas promocionales, CRM y adquisición de usuarios. Monitorear métricas de retención, reactivación y churn. Analizar el comportamiento de usuarios por segmento, producto y ciclo de vida. Detectar tendencias, anomalías y oportunidades de crecimiento a través de los datos. Realizar consultas en bases de datos mediante SQL. Automatizar reportes recurrentes y optimizar procesos de análisis. Apoyar a las distintas áreas con requerimientos de información y análisis ad hoc. Participar en seguimiento de KPIs de negocio. Presentar hallazgos y recomendaciones de manera clara y accionable. Requisitos Formación académica Licenciatura concluida: Actuaría | Economía | Ingeniería Industrial | Ingeniería en Sistemas | Ciencia de Datos | Finanzas | Carreras afines Experiencia 1 a 2 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, business intelligence o áreas afines. Conocimientos técnicos Indispensables: SQL intermedio | Excel avanzado | Power BI | Manejo de bases de datos | Estadística descriptiva Deseables: Conocimiento de herramientas CRM | Experiencia con plataformas de visualización de datos | Conocimiento de la industria de apuestas online, gaming o e-commerce | Python básico/intermedio para análisis de datos Competencias Pensamiento analítico | Curiosidad por entender el negocio | Atención al detalle | Capacidad para resolver problemas | Comunicación efectiva | Organización y gestión de prioridades | Proactividad | Orientación a resultados Indicadores de éxito Precisión y calidad de los reportes entregados. Tiempo de respuesta a requerimientos de información. Adopción y uso de dashboards por parte de las áreas de negocio. Generación de insights accionables que impacten KPIs comerciales. Automatización de procesos y reducción de tareas manuales. Ofrecemos Desarrollo profesional en una de las industrias digitales de mayor crecimiento. Exposición directa a áreas de Marketing, CRM, Producto y Dirección. Participación en proyectos estratégicos de negocio. Capacitación continua en herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos

Title: AI & Data Applications Engineer — Data, AI & Automation
Description: Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary. Summary: To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add an AI Developer Application located in Guadalajara, North Campus . We are seeking an AI Applications Engineer to design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications that automate workflows and unlock business insights across the organization. This role sits within the Business Intelligence function and combines AI application development with data engineering and reporting responsibilities , ensuring continuity of existing systems while accelerating adoption of modern AI capabilities. The ideal candidate is an engineer who enjoys building real systems, working close to data, and applying AI to solve meaningful business problems in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. What a typical day looks like: Design and develop AI-powered applications that automate business workflows and enhance data accessibility. Build and maintain internal tools that integrate AI capabilities with enterprise systems, databases, and APIs. Maintain and extend existing internal applications, , including three production systems—one of them legacy and undocumented—and two Ruby applications connected to Snowflake and other enterprise databases. Work within Linux-based environments to deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot applications. Connect to and manage remote systems using secure protocols. Reverse engineer existing systems when documentation is limited and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with the Business Intelligence team, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Continuously explore new AI tools, frameworks, and approaches to improve productivity and solution capabilities. Engineering degree required. Candidates must have formal engineering training with a strong foundation in analytical thinking, mathematics, and structured problem solving. Demonstrated ability to break down complex technical problems and design practical solutions, with a clear understanding of the business implications of those solutions. Fluent spoken and written English required. Candidates must be comfortable discussing technical and business topics with stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership. The experience we’re looking to add to our team (required): English Intermediate – Advanced. Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent systems experience. Engineering degree required (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related field). Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated ability to break down complex problems and deliver practical solutions. Ability to understand business context and design solutions with clear business impact. Strong communication skills with ability to interact effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Fluent spoken and written English required. AI & Automation Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, automation workflows, or intelligent tools. Experience working with LLM APIs, generative AI platforms, or AI-assisted development tools. Familiarity with tools such as: Copilot Studio Cortex AI Workflow automation tools (e.g., N8N or similar) Ability to design and implement AI-driven solutions integrating multiple systems and data sources. Data & BI Engineering Strong SQL expertise: Writing and optimizing complex queries Working with stored procedures, views, and large datasets Experience developing and maintaining ETL processes and data pipelines (SSIS or similar tools). Experience with enterprise reporting tools (SSRS or comparable platforms). Understanding of data modeling concepts, data flows, and enterprise data environments. Experience preparing structured data for analytics, reporting, and AI use cases. Software Engineering & Systems Experience building applications using Python, Ruby, or similar modern programming languages. Experience integrating systems via APIs and enterprise data platforms. Strong working knowledge of Linux environments for development and deployment. Experience managing remote systems and servers using SSH. Familiarity with platforms such as Snowflake or similar data stacks is a plus. Title: Staff Engineer - Python Developer
Description: Company Description We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000+ experts across 36 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in! Job Description Job Description: Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using Python. Collaborate directly with U.S. client teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Lead technical discussions, solution design sessions, and architecture reviews with client and internal stakeholders. Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend platforms. Work closely with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployments. Title: Software Engineer II
Description: En O'Reilly Autopartes México , estamos en búsqueda de un Software Engineer II con pasión por la tecnología, la innovación y el trabajo en equipo. Si te entusiasma enfrentar nuevos desafíos tecnológicos y mejorar constantemente el software que impacta directamente en el negocio, esta es tu oportunidad. Actividades del puesto: Liderarás proyectos a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software, garantizando que se entreguen soluciones innovadoras y de alta calidad. Gestionarás tareas y aplicarás principios de gestión de proyectos para asegurar la eficiencia y el éxito del equipo. Participarás y liderarás el desarrollo de varios proyectos simultáneamente, manteniendo siempre una visión integral. Propondrás mejoras y realizarás ajustes a los sistemas existentes para optimizar su rendimiento y adaptarlos a las necesidades del negocio. Diagnosticarás y resolverás problemas complejos de software, utilizando tu habilidad para el análisis y la solución de inconvenientes técnicos. Facilitarás reuniones para comprender los requisitos de software y colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de producto y las partes interesadas. Realizarás demostraciones de software para capacitar a otros equipos y garantizar el uso óptimo de nuestras soluciones tecnológicas. Desarrollarás software nuevo o modificarás el existente siguiendo las mejores prácticas de codificación. Mantendrás documentación técnica avanzada para asegurar la correcta implementación y mantenimiento de los proyectos. Asegurarás la calidad del software mediante rigurosas pruebas y depuración. Requisitos del puesto: 3+ años de experiencia en programación con Java / JavaScript . Conocimientos sólidos en React . Uso de bases de datos relacionales. Experiencia intermedia en el ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software (SDLC) y proyectos (PDLC). Capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas de manera eficiente, sin perder de vista la calidad. Experiencia avanzada en depuración y pruebas de software . Conocimiento profundo de sistemas informáticos complejos , incluyendo múltiples programas, bases de datos y comunicaciones. Sólida experiencia en programación, bases de datos y análisis y diseño de sistemas . Habilidad para redactar documentación técnica detallada. Inglés conversacional avanzado para interactuar con equipos internacionales.

Title: Test Engineer
Description: Meet the Team The Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO) Testing Engineering team is a vital part of Cisco’s Manufacturing ecosystem, focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of manufacturing processes and products. This team drives innovation and operational excellence by developing and executing rigorous testing strategies that support Cisco’s global manufacturing footprint. Your Impact As a Global Manufacturing Operation Testing Engineer technical leader, you will play a key role in validating manufacturing processes and product quality through comprehensive testing and analysis, also as a leader you will define the strategy and structure to be used on complex and new products while improving the technical skills of other test engineers. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize manufacturing workflows, troubleshoot issues, and implement improvements that enhance product reliability and customer satisfaction. Your work will directly impact Cisco’s ability to deliver high-quality products efficiently on a global scale. Develop, implement, and execute test plans and procedures for manufacturing processes and products. End to End test strategy ownership, helping to define test strategies from ICT to Functional system test optimizing Test time vs Throughput, Detection vs Escape risk and Coverage vs Cost. Decide what to test where in the process. Analyze test data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to resolve production issues and optimize testing methodologies. Support new product introductions by validating manufacturing readiness and process capability. Manage functional test capacity, expansion planning and execution. Develop and maintain functional test, system level test, Chamber, Burn-In, Stress test, Test fixtures and manage golden units. Experience on yield improvement based on Data Analytics, handle large datasets from manufacturing lines applying statistical methods like correlation and regression. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline with +10 years of experience in manufacturing test engineering within a global environment, complemented by a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, quality control, and product lifecycle management (PLM). Test Strategy & Data Analysis: Proven ability to develop and execute comprehensive test plans, utilizing advanced data analysis tools and software to interpret results and generate actionable insights. Compliance & Failure Analysis: Expertise in maintaining manufacturing compliance standards and documentation, combined with strong skills in Failure Analysis and Debug to lead root cause investigations for design, process, and component issues. Technical Specialization: Deep technical expertise in high-speed digital interfaces (SerDes, Optical, Ethernet), functional validation of complex boards, and testing of complete telecom systems. Technical Proficiency & Automation: Experience with manufacturing testing automation tools, combined with programming proficiency (e.g., Python, C/C#) and data analytics skills. Language Proficiency: Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate effectively and collaborate within a global technical environment. Preferred Qualifications Process Improvement: Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies to optimize manufacturing operations. Collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across global teams. Professional Mindset: A proactive problem-solving approach characterized by attention to detail and a consistent focus on quality and efficiency. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
